verdict.rationale: Pylon's own AI Reports feature lets users schedule automated summaries delivered to Slack. That is a genuine user-configurable recurring schedule, but it is limited to report generation. Triggers and Background Agents are documented as event-driven or asynchronous workflows, not time-based schedules, and the daily Salesforce sync is a built-in system behavior rather than a user-defined recurring job. Missing for 10: a general cron-style schedule for arbitrary workflows or agent jobs, documented schedule configuration (intervals, time zones), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: AI Reports allow you to schedule automated summaries of your data delivered directly to Slack.
